svg.title: A decision, then back together
svg.desc: flowchart. Start: New request; Decision: Is the request complete?; Process the request; Fill in the gaps; Merge: Joined; Finish: Ready to deliver. Connections: New request to Is the request complete?; Is the request complete? to Process the request: Yes; Is the request complete? to Fill in the gaps: No; Process the request to Joined; Joined to Ready to deliver; Fill in the gaps to Joined.
